description: Write RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_BASE_URL, RESEND_API_URL and EMAIL_FROM into a .env file in the project directory, and return only the names of what was written. RESEND_API_KEY here is a token for the platform's relay, not a Resend key, and it goes into the file and never into this conversation, so do not read the file back out to the user. These are the same variables the deployed app receives, so do not copy them into `set_env`. Variables already in the file are replaced, everything else is kept, and the file is added to .gitignore. Email has to be set up first: `email_create` does it. Needs the account token that `login` (or https://antideploy.com/agent.md) saves on this machine: a project key cannot read the token.

directory.description: The project folder. Defaults to this server's working directory.

file.description: A .env file inside the project directory. Default .env; .env.local suits Next.js.
